B's fallback suggests min-width separately from inline-block, and min-width does nothing on a plain inline span, so its backup advice is slightly less reliable. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers correctly blame proportional digits and give tabular-nums as the fix, and both stay under 80 words and on topic.
